Counsel for Applicant :- Ramakar Shukla,Aman Pandey,Subodh Kumar Pandey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.182 of 2024, under Sections 363, 366, 376(3)
IPC and Section 3/4 (2) of POCSO Act, Police Station Mailani, District Lakhimpur Kheri.
3. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report alleging that the daughter of the informant aged about 12 years was enticed by the applicant.

Subsequently, in the statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that for Saurabh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152869010/

sentences.text: the last seven years, they were having physical relations.
She also stated that she had gone with the applicant because she was scolded by her parents.
The tentative age of the victim is around 15-17 years.
she also stated that in her statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. that she wants to live with the applicant after attaining the age of 18 years.
4. The Counsel for the applicant stated that the applicant is also ready and willing to marry her when she will become 18 years.
He also argues that the medical report does ot corroborate the allegations.

5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.
6.

Considering these facts and the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 12.06.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Saurabh be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
